newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - TMM notes a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TMM notes a strong buy.

text.p: -- Mexico transportation company Transportacin Martima Mexicana (TMM) 8.5 percent and 9.25 percent notes were reiterated as a strong buy, Bear Stearns analyst Mark Agnew said in a report.
-- He said the ten percent notes are also a strong buy.
-- "Our analysis...indicates that TMM's credit strength will improve in 1997, contrary to the market's perception," Agnew wrote.

-- Bear Stearns analysts Santiago Pique and Marc McCarthy reiterated the brokerage's neutral recommendation on the stock, because of the negative impact on earnings from its operation and purchasing costs of the Northeast Railway concession. However, the company's potential looks encouraging, they said.
-- "We feel that the longer-term outlook of the company is promising and we believe that TMM constitutes an attractive long-term investment option," the analysts wrote.
